name: ImageLightbox
description: Image Lightbox, Responsive and Touch friendly
project_description:
The ImageLightbox module offers a straightforward solution for showcasing images within a lightbox interface.

 Features 
 
 Compatibility with image and media/image field types (version >2.1.0) 
 Image Lightbox that is Responsive and Touch-friendly 
 Minimalistic approach 
 Extensible & configurable field formatter 
 Responsive and touch-friendly. The most trending topics in web design and they are here. Images fit to any screen size and are swipe-able (native behavior) on touch capable devices. 
 Keyboard interaction: Incorporating standard, yet indispensable functionalities such as using the Arrow Left and Arrow Right keys to navigate through images and pressing Esc to exit the lightbox.
